summary: Use runtime semantics for the in operator because it observes prototype chains and proxy has traps.

target.notes: Evaluate left then right, require RHS to be Object or throw TypeError, convert the key to PropertyKey, and perform [[HasProperty]] including the prototype chain/Proxy trap.

caveats: Dictionary.ContainsKey checks own keys only and is not equivalent.

tests.name: edge inherited property and primitive rhs
tests.input: const p={x:1}; const o=Object.create(p); console.log('x' in o); try { console.log('x' in 1); } catch(e){ console.log(e.name); }
